add.event: 查韦斯将电力部门国有化，组建国营Corpoelec
add.evidence: Then-President Hugo Chávez created the state-run Corpoelec by nationalizing the electric sector and expelling private industry in 2007

add.event: 政府宣布“电力紧急状态”
add.evidence: The situation of "electrical emergency" decreed by the government on 21 December 2009 was suspended on 30 November 2010

add.event: 两次全国大停电后，查韦斯政府宣布临时限电计划
add.evidence: on 14 May 2011, after the country experienced two national blackouts, the government of Hugo Chávez announced a temporary rationing plan

add.event: 国民议会调查电力系统100 billion美元投资，认定逾80 billion美元被侵吞
add.evidence: In 2017, the National Assembly investigated the $100 billion dollars invested in the electrical system and determined that over $80 billion was embezzled
